items.quote: Mike and his team did an outstanding job pressure washing and sealing the pavers on our pool deck. He followed up to make sure that we were completely satisfied with their work, which of course we were. Cannot recommend Tampa Wash Pros enough.

Showed up on time, friendly and accommodating owner. Mike did the most thorough job cleaning my driveway and walkways and even took the time to clean the curb on the street side in addition to the sidewalk. I already booked again.
Happy Cleans It did a very thorough roof tile clean on my Dad's house. Roof had not been cleaned in 4 or 5 years, was pitch black. Looks brand new now. Will definitely use again and highly recommend!
